verses.1: And the Canaanite king, Ard, who ruled over the Negev region, heard that Israel had come through the wilderness. So he fought against Israel, and Israel was defeated by him.
verses.2: And Israel was under God’s control. They said, “If You give me this people into my hands, then I will destroy their cities.”
verses.3: And Jehovah heard the cry of Israel. He gave over the Canaanites, and he destroyed them along with their cities. He named that place “Harma”.
verses.4: And they traveled from Mount Horeb along the road to Sea of Galilee, in order to take possession of the land of Edom. But the strength of the people diminished along the way.
verses.5: And the people spoke to God and to Moses, saying, “Why have you brought us out of Egypt only for our death in the desert? There is no bread, and there is no water. Our souls are exhausted from the hunger.”
verses.6: And Jehovah sent out the scorpions to attack the people. They killed many people from Israel.
verses.7: And the people came to Moses and said, “We have sinned, because we have spoken against God. We have prayed to Jehovah, asking Him to remove the serpent from us. Moses prayed for the people’s sake.”
verses.8: And the LORD said to Moses, “Make for yourself a stick of wood. Place it on the rock, and all those who are trapped will be freed. Then they will see it and be saved.”
verses.9: And Moses made a serpent. He placed it on the pole. If the serpent bit anyone, they would look at the serpent and survive.
verses.10: And the children of Israel went forth and camped at Obos.
verses.11: They traveled from Opho, and they stopped at the shores of the straits that lie on the coast of Moab, to the east of the sun.
verses.12: From there, they traveled and stopped at the Zared River.
verses.13: From there, they traveled and stopped at Arnon. Arnon is located on the coast that extends from the border of Amorite territory. Arnon lies between Moab and Amorite territory.
verses.14: Therefore, it is said in the list of battles of Jehovah: “Vahav and Nehalim Arnon.”
verses.15: And I will make those rivers flow towards the city, so that they can serve as a source of water for the people living in that region.
verses.16: And from there, in the river, is the river that Jehovah said to Moses: “You shall gather the people together, and I will give them water to drink.”
verses.17: Then Israel will sing this song over the Euphrates River.
verses.18: In the places where they buried their dead, the kind-hearted people of that land mourned over them in peace and tranquility.
verses.19: And from Nahaliel and from Nahaliel in death.
verses.20: And from the heights of Gaya, which are located in the field of Moab, at the head of Pisga, it was seen opposite the faces of Yishimon.
verses.21: And Israel sent demons to Sishen, the king of the Amorites.
verses.22: I will pass through your land, not resting in the fields or in the orchards. I will walk along the path of the king, until I reach your borders.
verses.23: And Sihon did not allow Israel to pass through his land. So Sihon gathered all his people and went out to meet Israel at the Jordan River. Then Yahze’ah came out and fought against Israel.
verses.24: And Israel conquered it according to the terms of the treaty. They inherited its land from Arnon down to Yabok, and even to the children of Ammon. For Ammon’s children were indeed a formidable enemy.
verses.25: And Israel took all these cities. Israel settled in all the Amorite cities, both those with walls and those without walls.
verses.26: For Sihon was a king of the Amorites. He fought against Moab’s king. He took all of their land from him, right down to Arnon.
verses.27: Therefore, the rulers will say, “Let us build a city in Sion.”
verses.28: For fire came out from the darkness, from the pit of Sion. It consumed those who died in battle.
verses.29: Oh, you wretched people! You have perished like those who were given their children as slaves. Your sons and daughters have become slaves to the king of Elam, Sishon.
verses.30: And their men were lost, their thoughts were gone forever. And the women too were lost, until they could be brought back again.
verses.31: And Israel settled in the land of the Amorites.
verses.32: And Moses sent Rahel to take Yaazir captive. They captured her daughters, and Moses took the Amorite woman as his wife.
verses.33: And they turned around and went up the mountain. They left the mountain to go out into battle. They and all their people went out to fight.
verses.34: And the LORD said to Moses, “Do not be afraid of him. For I have given him into your hands, along with all his people and their land. You will do to him what you did to Sihon, the king of the Amorites, who ruled in Hesbon.”
verses.35: And they killed him, along with his sons and all his people. They didn’t leave any survivors for him. They took over his land.
